shared_elements: carved/incised relief on a flat rectangular slab
non-figural symbolic signs rather than naturalistic scenes
outlined forms with raised or grooved contours
justification: Both surfaces bear abstract, non-naturalistic carved signs on a flat rectangular panel, but that is the extent of the correspondence: A is a dense grid of many small rounded, densely packed pictorial glyph blocks in ordered rows and columns, while B is a single large symmetrical composition of an interlaced knot-like ring above a flaring tapered shaft. Nothing in the specific motifs, their relationships, or their placement corresponds, and the linear interlace convention of B is unlike the modelled, cartouche-framed sign forms of A.
